messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny R graphical design
parts:
Theme customization is already possible using both the theme parameter on fluidPage and other page functions, which take standard bootstrap theme stylesheets. For more font and color customization, yes, CSS is the right avenue to pursue. The good news is that it's quite simple to learn and quite simple to integrate with your Shiny app.

If you're asking for slicker styles to be included right "in the box", that's something we are considering, would love to hear feedback on this if others want to chime in.

messages.author: e2ca5093917af03b
messages.subject: Re: Shiny R graphical design
parts:
Best I could find is:

- Use one of bootswatch free themes ( they are recommended ? by shinyR staff, and from my experience they are pretty and generally supported - with minor workarounds- by shiny R - see the results, if you are interested dodxtx.com)
 - use charts.js for graphs and charts
 - use shinyJS for button activation/ disabling and other basic java script functions initiated from server.

-  use shinyBs for tooltips, modals and collapsable

It's all free and easy to use, and looks good....

Templates like the one on forest theme may not ( or may - who knows? ) work out of box with shiny R anyways.... 

Best
Luke
